steps.text: Search the shelf in the south building of Mort'ton.
Read the diary.
Add ashes to a tarromin potion (unf).
Use the serum 207 on Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Talk to Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
choices: What are all these shadowy creatures?
Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.

steps.text: Kill 5 Loar Shades and pick up their remains.
Kill 4 Loar Shades and pick up their remains.
Kill 3 Loar Shades and pick up their remains.
Kill 2 Loar Shades and pick up their remains.
Kill 1 Loar Shades and pick up their remains.
Use the serum 207 on Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Talk to Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, and 25 swamp paste from Razmire's builders' store.
choices: Can you open a store for me?
Can I see the building store please?

steps.text: Buy some olive oil from Razmire's general store, and 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks, and 25 swamp paste from their builders' store. Afterwards, use some serum 207 on Ulsquire.
choices: Can you open a store for me?
Can I see the general store please?

steps.text: Talk to Ulsquire in the east of Mort'ton.
Talk to Ulsquire again.
choices: What can you tell me about that temple?

steps.text: Repair the temple north east of Mort'ton. Do this on World 377 to make it faster and easier.
Keep repairing the temple until 20 sanctity.
Light the fire altar
Use the olive oil on the temple's fire.
Use a serum 207 (with 2 or more doses) on the temple's fire.
Use the sacred oil on a log.

items.name: A log whose pyre version you can burn

steps.text: Use the pyre log in a funeral pyre, then a loar remain. Finally, burn it.

items.name: A pyre log you can burn

steps.text: Use the serum 208 on Razmire in the north of Mort'ton.
Use some serum 208 on Ulsquire in the east of Mort'ton.
Talk to Ulsquire to finish the quest.

required.name: A log whose pyre version you can burn
Coins for building materials, or 18000 if you want to buy a Flamtaer hammer

recommended.name: A Mort'ton teleport or Barrows teleport tablet

notes: Whilst in Mort Myre, the Ghasts will occasionally rot the food in your inventory and steal charges from your Druid Pouch.
It's strongly recommended to bring a Flamtaer hammer and Flamtaer bracelets, as they speed up the temple repair section massively.
rewards: Ability to play the Shades of Mort'ton Minigame
